page.overview:
Who is Dr. von Sant?

Von Sant worked as a doctor and therapist for Blofeld's sham clinic, Piz Gloria, and treated Bond at the clinic after a helicopter ride.

What happens to Dr. Von Sant afterwards is unknown as he wasn't seen onscreen in the movie, only being mentioned by Irma Bunt, though one possibility is that he was one of the many casualties of the assault on Piz Gloria.
